Essential APIs for working with Okio. 
 * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

methods.name: public static BufferedSource buffer(Source source)
methods.comment:
* Returns a new source that buffers reads from {@code source}. The returned
   * source will perform bulk reads into its in-memory buffer. Use this wherever
   * you read a source to get an ergonomic and efficient access to data.

methods.name: public static BufferedSink buffer(Sink sink)
methods.comment:
* Returns a new sink that buffers writes to {@code sink}. The returned sink
   * will batch writes to {@code sink}. Use this wherever you write to a sink to
   * get an ergonomic and efficient access to data.

methods.name: public static Sink sink(OutputStream out)
methods.comment: Returns a sink that writes to {@code out}.

methods.name: private static Sink sink(final OutputStream out, final Timeout timeout)
public static Sink sink(Socket socket) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Returns a sink that writes to {@code socket}. Prefer this over {@link
   * #sink(OutputStream)} because this method honors timeouts. When the socket
   * write times out, the socket is asynchronously closed by a watchdog thread.

methods.name: public static Source source(InputStream in)
methods.comment: Returns a source that reads from {@code in}.

methods.name: private static Source source(final InputStream in, final Timeout timeout)
public static Source source(File file) throws FileNotFoundException
methods.comment: Returns a source that reads from {@code file}.

methods.name: public static Sink sink(File file) throws FileNotFoundException
methods.comment: Returns a sink that writes to {@code file}.

methods.name: public static Sink appendingSink(File file) throws FileNotFoundException
methods.comment: Returns a sink that appends to {@code file}.

methods.name: public static Source source(Socket socket) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Returns a source that reads from {@code socket}. Prefer this over {@link
   * #source(InputStream)} because this method honors timeouts. When the socket
   * read times out, the socket is asynchronously closed by a watchdog thread.

methods.name: private static AsyncTimeout timeout(final Socket socket)
private static boolean isAndroidGetsocknameError(AssertionError e)
methods.comment:
* Returns true if {@code e} is due to a firmware bug fixed after Android 4.2.2.
   * https://code.google.com/p/android/issues/detail?id=54072
